verdict.rationale: Railway's own marketing claims you can "run your application closer to where your users are," so the core idea of deploying near end users is a documented first-party capability. That claim is a single thin line, with no detail on regions, automatic geo-routing, or a true global edge network as opposed to choosing a region. Missing for 10: documentation of a global edge network or points-of-presence, list of available regions, automatic routing of users to the nearest instance, multi-region replica docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run my code on a global edge network close to end users

citations.quote: Run your application closer to where your users are.
